lines.say: Imagine building a boat so big that every kind of animal fits inside. That's the story of Noah!
The Bible says God told Noah: a great flood is coming. Build an ark!
So Noah grabbed his hammer and started building. Day after day, plank after plank.
His neighbors laughed at him. A giant boat, far away from the sea?
Then the animals came. Elephants, giraffes, lions and sheep, walking in two by two!
Dark clouds rolled in, and the first drops of rain began to fall.
It rained for forty days and forty nights, and the ark floated on a stormy sea.
Inside, Noah, his family and all the animals waited together.
When the rain finally stopped, Noah sent out a dove to look for dry land.
The dove came back with an olive leaf in its beak. Land was near!
The ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat, and everyone stepped out.
And God put a rainbow in the sky, as a promise. Follow for more Bible stories!
